consumedSemantics: already-bound final source may remain historical evidence only for the same daily My Day and is never consumed again
eveningAdjustment: historical Morning bound to X plus fresh Evening updates X with two-phase 70/30 weighting and consumes only Evening
idempotency: orchestration identity excludes consumed/fresh role and session revision so generation-success/consume-failure retry converges
forbidden: raw answers in My Day command
direct checkin DB reads from My Day
